ayahs.tr: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
ayahs.tl: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

ayahs.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.tr: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
ayahs.tl: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

ayahs.tr: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.tl: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

ayahs.tr: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
